verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Audit Log Webhooks that stream audit events into your own infrastructure. Because every admin action is logged, this is a real outbound HTTP event channel a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single line, and it covers only audit-log events; nothing shows general flag-change or environment event subscriptions. missing for 10: documented webhook registration flow, event-type selection or filtering, payload schema, signing/verification and retry semantics, webhooks for events beyond audit logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
